paper_baseline.description: Initial at-the-money replication case. K=150 and T2=1 year follow the Week 3 task requirement.

data_driven_case.description: JPM case based on the final available Week 2 observation.

assumptions: This is a European simple chooser option.
The choice date must satisfy 0 < T1 < T2.
T1=0.5 is an explicit initial assumption because the task brief specifies T2=1 but does not specify T1.
The original BSM baseline assumes constant volatility and zero dividend yield.
